title: About KPGU | Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University
content: ed excellence in education and research outreach. Core Values The core values that underpin who we are to permeate the mission and assist in achieving its vision. The university respects the differences among individuals irrespective of socio-economic status, geographic location, religion, and cultural background so as to harbinger the perspective for the benefit of society. The core values translated into value statements represent the hallmark of KPGU as an institution of higher learning.
